data.evidence_sentence: New for fall 2027, applicants must provide self-reported ACT or SAT test scores to be considered for this highly competitive opportunity.
data.notes: Page does not state nationality, GPA entry requirement or field of study. A 3.50 cumulative GPA is required each year to keep the scholarship (renewal condition, not an entry requirement). Students must indicate interest on the admission application. Dec. 1 deadline has no year stated, so recorded as annual. Selection is for fifteen Presidential Fellows per year, with semi-finalists and invitation-only finalist interviews in February. Enrichment fund of up to $5,000 requires a separate application and is not a stipend. Host country inferred from the university name and .edu domain.
